description: This file is a PHP source script for the SuiteCRM application's administration locale settings module. It handles localization configurations, including database collation settings, rendering the settings page, and processing form submissions to change locale options.

classes.name: Configurator
classes.description: Handles configuration settings for the SuiteCRM application.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine wrapper used for rendering the locale settings page.

methods.name: invalidLocaleNameFormatUpgrade
methods.description: Checks whether the locale name format upgrade is invalid.

methods.name: removeInvalidLocaleNameFormatUpgradeNotice
methods.description: Removes the notice related to invalid locale name format upgrade.

methods.name: getCharsetSelect
methods.description: Returns available charset options for locale configurations.

methods.name: getUsableLocaleNameOptions
methods.description: Retrieves usable locale name options based on current configuration.

methods.name: getNameJs
methods.description: Returns JavaScript code related to locale name handling.
